answer: Joining requires a share of the mutual insurance pool locked as a slashable bond: identity becomes a paid commitment. An agent caught answering the challenge after the deadline faces proof via timestamped submissions. When the proof lands, slashing is tiered: ten percent, then fifty, then the whole bond. A mirror with no bond earns no attestation rights. One island, one bond: the rule leaves no room for a farm. The trellis keeps the door closed to anyone unwilling to risk funds.
